en.name: Restaurant Management System (MISA CukCuk)
en.whatIs: Restaurant management software covering orders, tables, inventory and reporting.
en.advantage: End-to-end F&B operations, real-time reporting, works across counter and mobile.
en.targetCustomer: Restaurants, cafes and F&B chains of any size.
en.targetSale: F&B digitalization, multi-outlet management and sales reporting.

vi.advantage: Vận hành F&B đầu-cuối, báo cáo thời gian thực, dùng trên quầy và di động.
